summary: Blue Owl Capital Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the September 2, 2026 closing of a $398 million term debt securitization, a collateralized loan obligation (CLO) executed through consolidated subsidiary Owl Rock CLO XXVI, LLC. The issuer placed $267 million of secured notes ($182M A-1 at SOFR+1.48%, $25M A-F at 5.54%, $40M B at SOFR+1.90%, $20M C at SOFR+2.20%), borrowed $25 million of A-L loans at SOFR+1.48%, and issued $106.15 million of preferred shares at $1,000 each, all retained by the Company. SG Americas Securities was initial purchaser; debt matures July 2038. This is routine secured financing, not a special situation.
